caption: Energy Twin
text: This is Energy Twin, a digital twin for existing hotels. See the savings before you spend.

caption: A guided tour for first-time users
text: First-time users get a guided tour: a quick one in eight steps, or the full one.

caption: 1 · A city-scale twin
text: Chapter one: a city-scale twin.

caption: Your whole hotel portfolio at a glance
text: The homepage shows the whole portfolio: energy spend, savings potential and carbon across five Chicago hotels.

caption: Start with the top opportunity, not the biggest bill
text: It tells the chain where to start. Not the biggest bill, but the best ten-year return per dollar invested.

caption: Chicago in 3D, every hotel on it
text: Every hotel sits on a 3D map of Chicago, built from OpenStreetMap buildings, and colored by the metric you choose.

caption: Click a hotel: the camera flies in among the towers
text: Click a hotel, and the camera flies in among the towers.

caption: Optional data columns: height proportional to the selected metric
text: Optional data columns raise each hotel's metric above the city. They're data, not building heights.

caption: 2 · One budget, the whole chain
text: Chapter two: one budget for the whole chain.

caption: Split one budget across the chain
text: The portfolio optimizer tests every hotel's options and funds the best mix within one budget.

caption: Every dollar on this bar is a package the engine evaluated
text: Every dollar on this bar is a package the engine evaluated. Placeholder costs are named, and it's all labeled as a projection.

caption: Ask about the whole chain
text: You can also ask the AI about the whole chain. It asks the engine to rank the hotels or split a budget.

caption: 3 · Fly into the building
text: Chapter three: fly into the building.

caption: Its digital twin: the building, its energy, its costs
text: Here's the hotel's digital twin: the building, its energy and its costs.

caption: The hotel at a glance: a short briefing and the top opportunities
text: The sidebar gives a short briefing and the top opportunities, each with one next step.

caption: Hotel health against ENERGY STAR and CBECS
text: Hotel health compares it with ENERGY STAR and national survey data, as context, not a rating.

caption: Each zone colored by what it costs
text: Each zone is colored by what it costs.

caption: A living building: a January night…
text: It's a living building. On a January night, the heating runs and lit windows are guests in their rooms…

caption: …and a July afternoon
text: …and on a July afternoon, cooling peaks. The hourly readout follows the model.

caption: Press play: night, morning, summer, winter
text: Press play, and the whole year runs: night and morning, winter and summer.

caption: Explode the floors to see inside
text: Explode the floors to see inside: lit rooms, rooms set back by smart controls, and the plant.

caption: Room by room: who is in, who is out, what each floor uses
text: Room by room, you can see who is in, who is out, and what each floor uses.

caption: The equipment you actually have
text: Correct the equipment the hotel actually has, and the baseline follows. A correction is never counted as a saving.

caption: Where the money goes: grid and gas → zones → uses
text: The flow view follows the money from the grid and the gas line to every zone and use.

caption: Switch to carbon: gas is cheap per unit but carbon-heavy
text: Switch it to carbon: gas is cheap per unit but carbon-heavy, so heating and hot water grow.

caption: Stress-test the hotel: a heat wave, a cold snap, price rises
text: Stress tests show what a heat wave, a cold snap or a price rise would add to the bill.

caption: 4 · Ask the AI to test a decision
text: Chapter four: ask the AI to test a decision.

caption: Ask in plain English, by typing or with the mic
text: Ask in plain English, by typing or with the mic.

caption: The engine computes the what-if; the AI explains it
text: The AI doesn't guess. It asks the engine to run the what-if, and every number it quotes is checked against the model.

caption: One click puts it on the twin
text: One click puts the result on the twin.

caption: Now test a fix: turn on smart room controls
text: Now test a fix: smart room controls set back empty rooms automatically. See what that saves before buying anything.

caption: 5 · What should she buy?
text: Chapter five: what should she buy?

caption: Find the best investments for a $150,000 budget
text: The optimizer tests every upgrade combination within the budget, with comfort limits and confirmed incentives counted.

caption: The top package: cost, yearly savings, payback, 10-year value, carbon
text: Here's the top package, with its cost, yearly savings, payback, ten-year value and carbon.

caption: The 10-year projection: what you pay, what it saves as prices rise, when it pays back
text: The ten-year projection shows what you pay, what it saves as prices rise, and when it pays back.

caption: Why not solar? It pays back far more slowly here
text: Why not solar? On the same assumptions, it pays back far more slowly here.

caption: Or build your own plan and compare it with the recommendation
text: Or build your own plan, and compare it side by side with the recommendation.

caption: Applied: before and after on the twin and the KPI strip
text: Apply the package, and the twin and the KPI strip show before and after.

caption: 6 · Hand it to the owner
text: Chapter six: hand it to the owner.

caption: One click: a PDF report for the owner and the bank
text: One click creates a PDF report for the owner and the bank, with every assumption listed and every estimate labeled.

caption: How was this calculated? Every figure explains its sources
text: Every key figure explains how it was calculated, and where the data comes from.

caption: Load 12 months of bills to calibrate the model to the real building
text: And loading twelve months of utility bills calibrates the model to the real building.

caption: Back to the chain: the map is as she left it
text: Back to the chain: the map is right where she left it.

caption: Simulate smarter. Spend better. Save energy.
text: Energy Twin. Simulate smarter. Spend better. Save energy.
